Option B — Rush small batch run + next-day air to Moscone: 1 business day reprint + overnighting to venue — $980 for notebooks, $450 for pins (total $1,430) before tax. We can split shipments: pins today (small pack from existing stock) and notebooks tomorrow AM.

If you choose B we will pick up with priority at 03:00 tomorrow and deliver to Moscone loading dock (VE contact looped for on-site acceptance). We will issue a 15% credit on the defective run. Please confirm and we will process the rush PO.
